title: BBUL (Publication)
summary: A publication for BBUL: each of the 16 artists answers two questions on a sheet of their own, shown as stacks to take away and as a row on the wall.
credits:
Artists: GuNa, Camelostrich, Cho Leesop, Chae Soojin, Choi Heewon, Han Goeun, Hong Yejin, Jeong Duldol, Jiiho, Kim Dohyeon, Kim Jane Kyuwon, Kim Haerri, Lee Yujin, Lee Yewon, Na Junheum, Noh Hyejin
Graphic Design: Junyeol Baek
description: Every artist in the relay was asked the same two questions — what is the 'BBUL' growing inside you, and what does drawing it mean to you. Each answer is printed on a grey sheet with the date and hour of their turn, a debossed triangle and a short text on their practice. On the wall, the sheets hang in drawing order, each marked with a black wooden triangle bearing the artist's name.
